contexts.text: Insanities are perceived to be exhaled from the falsities...
Into what insanities those things would fall (if they were said).
That nation had such insanity, that...
To such lengths does their insanity go.
The insane cupidity of possessing the goods of others.
By any insane love bursting forth...
(Insanity a cause of lawful separation.) (And of concubinage. CL 470:end.)
They become the insanities of their own concupiscence.

Christians turned to Judaism... in the other life become as if insane. The insane cannot exist among Spirits as they do in the life of the body; but their insanity consists in this, - that they are insane with the like phantasies as those who in the body are supposed to be sane. But they who betake themselves to Judaism are as if insane when they come among other Spirits. Described.
So that he who so insanely supposes that he can resist (the penalties there), may know that this is insanity.
Some go to such insanity (as to suppose that they can sin with impunity).
